good: Auto-drives at ~190 km/h with a locked chase cam; boost pushes to 300+ and reads instantly
Giant speed, segmented boost bar, X-marked takedown counter and RIVAL WRECKED toast all react live
Clear TAKEDOWN! moment with the rival wrecked and counter incrementing
bad: Scripted drive slams into walls and crashes in a loop — barriers are too grabby
Traffic is promised but often absent; several frames show a completely empty road
Cars and skyline are plain low-poly boxes, right down to the odd pyramids on the horizon
step-5-preview.one_line: Fast, punchy and very Burnout on the HUD, but the box-car world and crash-happy walls keep it from feeling like the real thing.

good: The sunset city skyline has lit windows, overhead gantry signs and streetlights, so the world reads as a real highway
There is a yellow rival with a RIVAL tag. Three to four TAKEDOWN! banners show in play, each with a subtitle (wall or traffic takedown)
The Burnout-style HUD has a big km/h readout, a segmented boost bar, a takedown counter and a CRASHED banner
bad: The player crashes very often from small steering inputs. Speed drops to 0 many times, which breaks the flow
Cars are low-poly blocks and the road surface is a flat dark plane. There is little speed blur or FOV kick at 290+ km/h
The rival wreck is small and far away. The takedown moment has no slow-mo or crash cam, so the hit has little punch
opus-5.5.one_line: A good-looking, fast, low-poly Burnout clone with real takedowns, but you crash into traffic every few seconds and the takedowns don't hit hard.
